title: That All You Got — EN/HI/SW (Chas McIvor)
style: country blues acoustic guitar Hindi Swahili language learning warm baritone 108bpm walking bass brushed drums trilingual rugby true story Australian family
lyrics:
[Verse 1 - English]
Two men. His back. He rolled.
"That all you got, boys?"
First grade. Not recreational.
A different kind of serious.

[Verse 2 - Hindi, with English translations]
दो आदमी। उसकी पीठ। वह लुढ़का। (Two men. His back. He rolled.)
उठ खड़ा हुआ। मुड़ा। (Stood up. Turned around.)
"बस यही है तुम्हारे पास, दोस्तों?" (That all you got, boys?)
फर्स्ट ग्रेड। यह विशिष्ट है। (First grade. That is specific.)
मनोरंजन नहीं। (Not recreational.)
एक अलग तरह की गंभीरता। (A different kind of serious.)
जिस तरह से वह लुढ़का (The way he rolled)
वह प्रशिक्षण का काम था। (Was training at work.)

[Chorus - Swahili, with English translations]
Je, hiyo ndiyo yote uliyonayo (That all you got)
Alisema kwa urahisi (He said it easy)
Je, hiyo ndiyo yote uliyonayo (That all you got)
Alirudi kutoka nafasi iliyorejeshwa (Turned from a recovered position)
Je, hiyo ndiyo yote uliyonayo (That all you got)
Daraja la kwanza kwa kiwango cha ulimwengu halisi (First grade at real-world scale)
Joel Aaron McIvor (Joel Aaron McIvor)
Je, hiyo ndiyo yote uliyonayo (That all you got)

[Bridge - all three]
English: Dad. Pete. Joel. The lineage knew what to do.
Hindi: पिता। पीट। जोएल। वंश जानता था क्या करना है। (Dad. Pete. Joel. The lineage knew what to do.)
Swahili: Baba. Pete. Joel. Ukoo ulijua la kufanya. (Dad. Pete. Joel. The lineage knew what to do.)

[Outro - all three]
English: Standing clean — first grade — that all you got
Hindi: सीधा खड़ा — फर्स्ट ग्रेड — बस यही है (Standing straight — first grade — that all you got)
Swahili: Amesimama safi — daraja la kwanza — je hiyo ni yote (Standing clean — first grade — that all you got)
